# Dotfiles Project Memory

## Terminal manager is herdr, not tmux (2026-07-29)
- [herdr terminal manager](herdr-terminal-manager.md) — workspace→tab→pane; `pane run` has no idle-shell guard and types into live agents; don't kill his tmux session for him.

## `rc` panes are Remote Control, never `--resume`-able (2026-08-25)
- [claude-rc-not-resumable](claude-rc-not-resumable.md) — `rc` = `claude rc … --spawn worktree`; herdr reports a UUID **v5** placeholder with a 0-byte transcript, so `claude --resume` always fails. v5 vs v4 is the tell.

## Unlanded herdr-titles hooks fix (2026-08-11)
- [herdr-titles-hooks-fix-pending](herdr-titles-hooks-fix-pending.md) — remind Craig to land `fix/herdr-titles-duplicate-hooks` in the claude-code-plugins worktree; the sibling title plugins still double-register hooks.

## Key Files
- `~/.dotfiles/zshrc` → symlinked to `~/.zshrc` (cross-platform)
- `~/.dotfiles/zshrc.mac` → symlinked to `~/.zshrc.local` (mac-specific)
- `~/.dotfiles/zshenv` → `~/.zshenv`
- `~/.dotfiles/zprofile` → `~/.zprofile`
- `~/.dotfiles/env.mac` → `~/.env.local` (mac-specific)
- `~/.dotfiles/p10k.zsh` → `~/.p10k.zsh`
- `~/.zprofile.local` — contains `gh auth token` via 1Password plugin
- p10k installed at `~/.oh-my-zsh/custom/themes/powerlevel10k` → symlink to `~/.dotfiles/git-clones/romkatv/powerlevel10k`

## User has two machines
- Mac (M4 Max, macOS Sequoia 15.7.3) — **PERSONAL**, uses `*.mac` files
- Linux — **WORK** (Two Sigma), uses `*.2s` files. Work forbids PATs.
  **git 2.32.0**, and the public internet is blocked unless tunnelled
  through `gssproxy2`, so mise is impractical there.
- `.zshrc` is cross-platform; `.zshrc.local`/`.env.local` are platform-specific
- Personal secrets in `*.mac` files are fine — work never reads them
- Suffix is `.2s`, NOT `.ts` — `.ts` is TypeScript to oxfmt/editors/linguist
  and the pre-commit hook rejects it. See [dotfiles-machine-specific-files.md](dotfiles-machine-specific-files.md)

## Zsh Startup Optimization (2026-03-09)
See [zsh-startup.md](zsh-startup.md) for details.

## Secrets must never be committed (2026-05-16, corrected 2026-07-14)
See [secrets-history-scrub.md](secrets-history-scrub.md) — `secrets` is untracked/gitignored only; private branch history was scrubbed of real tokens. Verified the scrubbed blob was **private-repo-only, never public** — `OSSRH_TOKEN` rotation is hygiene, not urgent.

## Branch topology: `work` is on the PUBLIC remote (2026-07-14)
See [dotfiles-branch-topology.md](dotfiles-branch-topology.md) — two remotes, three branches; `work` pushes to public/dotfiles, not private. Daily bot re-advances submodules, so backward pins don't stick. Also: mac=personal / linux=work file-suffix mapping, and the preference for env-specific files over branches.

## Machine-specific files over branches (2026-07-14)
See [dotfiles-machine-specific-files.md](dotfiles-machine-specific-files.md) — `.mac`/`.2s` suffixes, `./install 2s`, and which `.local` hook fires when (zshenv=early, zshrc:140=mid, p10k needs a post-184 hook).

## git conflictStyle can't be overridden per-machine (2026-07-14)
See [git-conflictstyle-parse-time.md](git-conflictstyle-parse-time.md) — git validates it at *parse* time, so old git dies before reaching the `[include]`. `git config --get` skips validation and will lie to you. Tried and abandoned once before.

## gitstatusd lost to cache wipe (2026-05-21)
See [gitstatusd-cache-wipe.md](gitstatusd-cache-wipe.md) — p10k "gitstatus failed to initialize"; disk cleanup wiped `~/.cache`. Binary reinstalled into `~/.cache/gitstatus/` (canonical location — `usrbin/` would break p10k's auto-update).

## Backblaze walk CPU: NO exclusion reduces the scan (2026-07-19)
See [backblaze-walk-cpu-xattr.md](backblaze-walk-cpu-xattr.md) — bztransmit/bzfilelist 100% CPU is the scan of ~6M files. NOTHING reduces it: bzdirfilter, excludefname_rule, and TM-xattr ALL only filter upload, not the scan (proven: `~/.cache` bzdirfilter'd for months, still 31k entries every walk). Only real fix = move giant dirs to an unselected volume, or throttle threads. Two wrong turns chased here (xattr, then bzdirfilter) — don't repeat.

## Zsh History Loss & Restore (2026-05-12)
See [zsh-history-restore.md](zsh-history-restore.md) — `~/.zsh_history` was wiped on 2026-05-12; restored from TM at `/Volumes/Backups of MacBook Pro M4 Max 1/<date>.previous/`. Root cause unknown.

### Root cause of ~10s startup
`/etc/zshrc` sets `HISTSIZE=2000`. User had `SAVEHIST=1000000000` but never set `HISTSIZE`. With 141K-line history file, zsh spent ~4.5s trimming history on every startup.

### Fix
Set `HISTSIZE=1000000` and `SAVEHIST=1000000` in zshrc.

### Other optimizations applied
- Cached `just` completions and `mise` completions
- Hardcoded brew paths (was `eval "$(brew shellenv)"`)
- Removed redundant `mise activate zsh --shims`
- Removed duplicate iterm2 shell integration source

### Debugging note
- macOS `/etc/zshrc` sets HISTFILE and HISTSIZE before user zshrc
- Setting HISTFILE in zshenv gets OVERRIDDEN by /etc/zshrc
- ZDOTDIR tests can mask history issues (different HISTFILE path)
- `gh` is aliased through 1Password (`op plugin run -- gh`) — do NOT bypass with direct binary path
